prune.inclusion_rule: direct source in [CLINGEN, DISGENET, OMIM, ORPHANET] and evidence_score >= 0.3, or evidence_score >= 0.6

Disease.reason: not anchored by a seed gene (inclusion rule / max_diseases_per_seed_gene), a seed term, an evidence edge or a claim

Drug.reason: no edge to a seed gene, no seed drug term, not referenced by evidence or a claim

Gene.reason: not a seed gene, not the gap probe, not referenced by evidence or a claim, beyond max_genes_per_disease or below the inclusion rule

Investigator.reason: no surviving edge, or fewer than min_papers_per_investigator (3) papers

Phenotype.reason: not annotated to an exported disease (nor an ancestor of one)

Variant.reason: not keep_in_graph, no somatic block, not referenced by a claim

gap_probe.name: ABCF2-H2BK1 readthrough
gap_probe.rule: alphabetically first protein-coding HGNC symbol among backbone genes with zero disease_gene, drug_gene, pathway_gene and biological_process_gene rows
